risks.title: Channel teams cannot adopt OAuth client credentials in time
risks.response: Mitigate: shared SDK and office hours; migrate the switch first

risks.title: Open security findings delay the security sign-off (M4)
risks.response: Mitigate: fix HSM-SEC-001 lockout in sprint 6; HSTS at gateway

risks.title: Key ceremony control failure repeats (audit finding OP-01)
risks.response: Mitigate: enforce custodian separation in the HSM console before migration

risks.title: HSM vendor lead time for spare units
risks.response: Accept: spares ordered, delivery confirmed for December

risks.title: Budget pressure from hardware price increases
risks.response: Mitigate: price variances escalated through procure-to-pay controls

risks.title: Key staff unavailable during year-end change freeze
risks.response: Mitigate: plan migrations around the 15 Dec - 5 Jan freeze

risks.title: Data centre network change slips installation

issues.title: API feature complete slipped three weeks (lockout and header stories)
Leavers still had SAP access (audit finding AC-01)

decisions.decision: Expose HSM services over REST with OAuth 2.0 client credentials
Use ISO-4 PIN blocks for new channels, keep ISO-0 for legacy
Security sign-off requires zero high-severity findings; medium findings need a dated plan

assumptions.assumption: Channels can test against the API sandbox from November
PCI PIN assessor available in March 2027
